2493-8043-8350.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
2493-8043-8350.description:
Cast Face Yourself for free due to Vision, targeting yourself and creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste and the noted exile clause.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Archaeomancer token enters, it triggers, returning Face Yourself from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

147-1070-2292.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1070-2292.description:
Cast Rise Again by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Rise Again.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Rise Again
Resolve the Rise Again copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

339-677-6495-7297.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

643-728-2366-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
643-728-2366-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1981-2415-4050-6823.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4050-6823.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

4153-4186-5231--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
When the creature token dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Repeat from step 5.

654-3129-4772-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2665-3455.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2665-3455.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Vizier of Many Faces and Progenitor Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Vizier of Many Faces trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Progenitor Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2665-3455.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1594-2781-6626-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1263-2301-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3033-5708-7275.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
3033-5708-7275.description:
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Vengeful Vampire.
Vengeful Vampire dies due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability and Vein Ripper
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Vengeful Vampire trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Champion of the Weird ability from step 1, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Vengeful Vampire, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Repeat.

2557-4659-5086-5183-6996.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2557-4659-5086-5183-6996.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

280-1558-2638-4231-4365.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
280-1558-2638-4231-4365.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Mondrak.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

465-3175-5686.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan from exile to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2364-2957-3767-3918.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Mana Vault's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

4867-5352.notablePrerequisites: There are three permanents on the battlefield that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{G}
4867-5352.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant or sorcery spells.
Cast Doppelgang by paying {12}{G}{U}, creating four token copies of Cormela and of the three mana-producing permanents.
Put the tapped Cormela and all but one Cormela token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering each of them once.
Resolve the first Cormela trigger, returning Doppelgang from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve all remaining Cormela triggers.
Activate twelve of the mana-producing permanent tokens by tapping them, adding at least {11}{G}.
Repeat.
4867-5352.notes: This combo makes infinite mana if you add {3} to casting Doppelgang originally. Once you have infinite tokens and mana, you may instead target any other permanents using Doppelgang.

864-4871-5231-6476.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
864-4871-5231-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Eternal Witness and at least three other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Thermopod four times by sacrificing four of the creatures returned in step 1, including Eternal Witness, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2719-2981-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces on the battlefield as a copy of Lonis.
2719-2981-5365.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.
2719-2981-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

3443-3995-5963.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
3443-3995-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Deathbloom Ritualist's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2060-3490-3910-4017.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional artifacts.
1270-2060-3490-3910-4017.description:
Activate Breya by paying {2} and sacrificing two other artifacts, causing you to gain 5 life.
Sunbond triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create three 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Repeat.

409-3617-4797.notablePrerequisites: Tormod's Cryptkeeper does not have summoning sickness.
409-3617-4797.description:
Activate Tormod's Cryptkeeper by tapping and sacrificing it, exiling your graveyard.
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Deadbridge Chant triggers, returning Time Walk to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: This combo can fail if other cards enter your graveyard after step 1.

1170-2450-3941.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Coveted Jewel.
Coveted Jewel enters the battlefield, causing you to draw three cards.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-4577-4647-5046.notablePrerequisites: Magnanimous Magistrate has at least one reprieve counter.
2034-4577-4647-5046.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Martyr for the Cause, adding {C}{C}.
Martyr for the Cause dies, triggering itself and Magnanimous Magistrate twice.
Resolve both Martyr for the Cause triggers, causing you to put two reprieve counters on Magnanimous Magistrate.
Resolve the first Magnanimous Magistrate trigger, choosing not to remove any counters.
Remove the second Magnanimous Magistrate trigger, causing you to remove two reprieve counters from Magnanimous Magistrate and return Martyr for the Cause from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1651-2751-3775-4659.notablePrerequisites:
You have the initiative.
You have completed a dungeon.
1651-2751-3775-4659.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Safana triggers.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Safana's ability.
Resolve the copy of Safana's ability, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasure tokens, untapping Strionic Resonator.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Treasure token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

3169-3484-4374.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, triggering Decoction Module and Genesis Chamber.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
The Myr enters the battlefield, triggering Decoction Module.
Resolve both Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.

643-1707-2818-4302.notablePrerequisites:
Floating Shield attached to Bishop of Wings.
"Black" chosen with Floating Shield.
You control an additional creature with toughness equal to one.
You have a way to deal damage to the creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
643-1707-2818-4302.description:
Deal damage to a creature you control with toughness equal to one.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
The creature dies as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, triggering Bishop of Wings' second ability, causing you to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
The Spirit enters the battlefield, as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, triggering Bishop of Wings' first ability, causing you to gain four life.
Last Laugh triggers, dealing 1 damage to each creature except Bishop of WIngs, as well as each player.
The Spirit dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-2732-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two other nontoken creatures.
2034-2732-4499.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two other nontoken creatures, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Prowling Geistcatcher triggers twice, exiling the sacrificed creatures from your graveyard.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Prowling Geistcatcher.
Prowling Geistcatcher leaves the battlefield, returning all creature cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1170-1414-2480.description:
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Tamiyo.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Tamiyo's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1623-2302-4215-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Guile.
Guile and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Guile trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Guile, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Guile's power.
Repeat.

65-717-864-2628-4607.description:
Activate Smoldering Crater's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
Bone Miser, Smoldering Crater, and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Smoldering Crater trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Eternal Witness.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Smoldering Crater from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
